Three TMC MPs Decline Joining BJP, Distance Themselves from NDA

Three Trinamool Congress (TMC) Members of Parliament, including Yusuf Pathan and Abu Tahir, have stated they will not join the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) or the National Democratic Alliance (NDA). This comes amid reports of a rift among "rebel" TMC MPs. The coverage does not specify the exact reason for their refusal to join the BJP or the NDA, nor does it detail the alleged rift among the MPs. It is also unclear if this decision impacts a larger group of 20 MPs.
